identity.name: Pasha de Cartier
identity.one_liner: The 2020 Pasha de Cartier in stainless steel with the screw-down crown guard and the QuickSwitch strap system — the modern reissue of the 1985 Pasha that defined Cartier's 1980s sport watch identity.

narrative.story: The 2020 Pasha de Cartier is the modern reissue of the 1985 Pasha (the watch Cartier designed for the "Pasha of Marrakech"). The 41mm stainless steel case, the screw-down crown guard with the chain attachment, and the QuickSwitch strap system are the 2020 redesign. The 1847 MC caliber is the same in-house automatic used in the Santos. The Pasha is the most-cited Cartier round sport watch of the 2020s and the watch a collector cites when they want a Cartier with a sport identity different from the Tank's rectangular case.
